capabilities: Hide the vault window to the GNOME system tray
Restore the hidden window from the panel menu
Keep background sync running after the window closes
Register a tray icon through a bundled Python helper
Restart or quit Obsidian from the tray menu
extras: Requires a GNOME panel with AppIndicators and system Python 3 (PyGObject, GTK 3, Ayatana AppIndicator 3); tested only on Ubuntu 24.04 with Obsidian 1.15.1. Companion plugin 'Start in Tray at Login' enables hidden startup at login. Early 0.1.x versions were based on Background Tray by Synaphi; 0.2.0 is an independent rewrite. Bilingual English/Russian README; MIT license.
problem: On GNOME, closing the Obsidian window quits the app and stops background sync, with no built-in way to keep it running hidden.

relations.evidence: Ранние версии 0.1.x в истории репозитория были основаны на Background Tray от Synaphi

requires.name: GNOME desktop with Ubuntu AppIndicators or a compatible StatusNotifier panel
Python 3 with PyGObject, GTK 3, and Ayatana AppIndicator 3

summary: Tray integration that hides the Obsidian window to the GNOME system tray so background sync continues, restoring it from the panel menu.
